items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: Dexter was in a big band, Illinois Jacquet, Don Byas, Ben Webster. All these guys were in big bands, but eventually they felt that they could have more freedom by being with a small group

ctx.x: in big bands to playing in smaller groups, some of the things that were involved there and some of the things you remember about that.

Well, in the big band it was like a family, 18 pieces. And then if you were a soloist, you know, you played the arrangements and when you come to your solo then you sit up and played your solo. But it was a confined thing, you see what I mean, like you might have two solos a night or you might have four solos a night, but the rest of the time you're just playin' parts, 'cause someone else is soloin' or you got a singer or whatever. But in a small group you have a chance to be more creative because you can play…

iment and it's just better for a soloist. Yes, umhum. That's why Coleman Hawkins, they come up in the big bands, and Dizzy and Bird was in a big band and Coltrane played in big bands and most of these guys that became soloists, eventually...Dexter was in a big band, Illinois Jacquet, Don Byas, Ben Webster. All these guys were in big bands, but eventually they felt that they could have more freedom by being with a small group, which proved to be true, you know. Yeah.
